own_solution.law: Angular momentum conservation about the axle; Q = (1/2) [I1 I2/(I1+I2)] w0^2

notes: All certified answers verified: base 33.84 J; I2 = 0.045 -> 41.80 J, 0.07 -> 50.25 J, 0.105 -> 57.18 J. Friction-torque cancellation is correct (Q = q * (I1 I2 w0^2 / (2 q (I1+I2)))). Minimal pairs T7B9A/T9108 and TE735/T145A share 0.04 kg*m^2 and differ only in attachment. In pass 1 I flagged rendering_not_minimal (medium) for the 'a small amount' sentences T3181 and T1AC4; pass 2 shows they are declared numeral-free controls (twins of TE735 and T7B9A), not claimed minimal pairs, so I withdraw that flag; the phrasing 'is a small amount' is somewhat awkward, hence slightly_artificial.
